notes.title: Void Edge of Existance v1.2.28
notes.content:
Hey All, 

I have just done some more updates towards the game as a whole these go as follows, 

Andral's Journal: 
This can be accessed through the [M] Button , this thus give you a breakdown of each boss, what items they drop, a preview of said boss and some accompanying lore around the boss/Mob

Info Widgets: 
[olist]
 Some info widgets have been placed into the game to get you started when playing the game, these are,
 The Core Trial Widgets: Showing where each trial starts so you can best find the trial you are on
 Info Tips The Core: giving a small overview of the game before entering the first trial to add to the tutorial.
 Gore'Dross Widget: Upon Slaying Gore'Dross the first time you will receive a widget which details the power system to make it more clear on how to progress.
[/olist]

Immunities: 

 A Few bosses have been altered with immunities to some of your abilities adding a little extra challenge when facing against them. this is to be more strategic with abilities and how you use them in higher level states. 
 This also comes with a widget telling you when an ability is immune on a boss. 


Item Drops:
Some item drops have been changed so they are easier to obtain but still factors in the element of RNG but still giving Reward to players who obtain them. 

 Xorbross: Item Drop 1/1000 to 1/200
 Gore'Dross: Item Drop 1/1000 to 1/100


Default Difficulty: 
Due to the game in the last major patch we introduced difficulties, the default difficulty has been set to Easy but still can be changed on the Main Menu. 
This is so players just starting to play the game have it still challenging but also giving them a chance to immerse in the storyline. 

Looking forward to building out Patch 1.3 and i hope you enjoy the latest update to Void, 
Have an Awesome Day, 
Dala(Jon)

notes.title: Void: Edge of Existence Patch 1.0.13
notes.content:
Hey All, There were a few Bugs found whish have thus been resolved, along with Adjustments and added Effects, these are;

Mobs/Boss Damage Calculations: this made it so when you hit 1 mobs it would effect all others and as such has been fixed. 

Gore'Dross Effect Mechanics: Gore'Dross has received a Buff as such when he is attacked he will spread fire around him dealing AOE Damage to the Player. along with a Health reduction to Balance this Buff out. 

Main Chacter Andral has received a Baseline buff increasing him Physical Damage to 50 from 20 and Shadow Damage to 40 from 20. Along with this he has also gone from 5 Essence Regen Every 3 Seconds to 15 Every 2 Seconds. This is intended to help players use more abilities as alot of the Boss are quite Tanky and Deal Alot of Damage as you Progress through the game. 

Overall i am working on one more bug which is the Ambience Non-switching bug and will provide a patch for this once i have resolved said bug. 

Have an Awesome Day,
Dala(Jon)
